services.desc: The Tandem Jetovator has twin controls, allowing it to be controlled from the front or rear seat. New riders can fly in comfort knowing they have an instructor or experienced rider in the back that can take over the controls at any time. An adventurous day at the lake, river or ocean can be even more thrilling when flying above water with your friends on the new Jetovator Tandem Jetbike. Each Tandem Jetovator is custom made in the United States and requires 2 weeks build time. Already have an X-Jets, Flyboard or Jetovator U-pipe and Hose?
